name: NY-24
label: Likely R

key_factors: The district's R+11 partisan lean strongly favors incumbent Claudia Tenney
Tenney holds a roughly 7-to-1 fundraising edge and more than 10-to-1 cash advantage over Alissa Ellman
Prediction markets price a Republican win at about 96 percent
No public polling or expert ratings indicate a competitive race
model.rationale: An R+11 district, Tenney's overwhelming money advantage, and markets pricing a Republican win near certainty all point to her holding the seat; even a Democratic-friendly national environment narrows the margin but not the likely outcome.
model.watch: Reliable polling showing the race inside single digits amid a strong Democratic national wave would be the main signal of a genuine contest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Claudia Tenney enters this central New York race as a clear favorite. The district leans Republican by about eleven points on partisan fundamentals, and she holds an overwhelming financial edge, having raised roughly seven times as much as Democratic challenger Alissa Ellman while keeping more than ten times the cash on hand. Prediction markets give Tenney roughly a 96 percent chance of holding the seat, and expert raters do not list the race as competitive.

Ellman, a non-incumbent, faces an uphill climb with limited resources and no public polling suggesting a close contest. A favorable national environment for Democrats could narrow the margin somewhat, but the combination of district lean, incumbency, and money makes an upset unlikely. The expected outcome is a comfortable Republican win in the mid-teens.
